questions.question: Why is your lane position important when riding a motorcycle?

options.text: It has little effect on whether other drivers can see you.
It is very important because it affects whether other drivers can see you.
It cannot protect you from wind blasts from other vehicles.

questions.correctAnswerText: It is very important because it affects whether other drivers can see you.
questions.explanation: A good lane position helps other drivers see you and helps you see the road better. It also protects you from wind created by other vehicles.

questions.question: Which material provides the best protection for motorcycle riders?
questions.explanation: Leather and sturdy synthetic materials offer the best protection for motorcycle riders.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a regulatory sign with white background and red and black markings. It tells drivers that right turns are not allowed.

questions.question: A pre-ride inspection should include all of the following, except:

options.text: A test of the turn signals.

questions.explanation: Before riding, check your tires, controls, lights, signals, mirrors, brakes, oil, fluids, chassis, and stands. A paint inspection is not necessary.

questions.question: When riding, you should wear:
questions.explanation: Wear bright colors to be more visible to other drivers, even during the day. Reflective materials also help increase visibility.

questions.question: What is the best way to stop quickly?

options.text: Use both brakes at the same time.

questions.correctAnswerText: Use both brakes at the same time.
questions.explanation: Apply controlled pressure to both the front and rear brakes at the same time for the quickest stop.

questions.question: What should you wear when riding during the day?

options.text: Clothing of any color because drivers can see you in daylight.
Dark clothing to contrast with the bright sunlight.

questions.explanation: Most motorcycle crashes happen in daylight. Always wear bright colors to make yourself more visible, even during the day.

questions.question: How can you become sober after drinking alcohol?
questions.explanation: Only time allows your body to remove alcohol. No other method speeds up this process.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a warning sign with yellow background and black symbols. It warns drivers that traffic is merging ahead.

questions.question: Which color makes you less visible to other drivers?
questions.explanation: Wear bright orange, red, yellow, or green clothing to be more visible. Avoid drab or dark colors while riding.

questions.question: How do reflective, brightly-colored helmets and clothing help motorcycle riders?

options.text: They should only be worn when riding at night.
They help other drivers see you better.
They do not make riding safer.

questions.correctAnswerText: They help other drivers see you better.
questions.explanation: Brightly-colored or reflective clothing makes it easier for other drivers to see you on the road.

questions.question: When using saddlebags to carry items, what should you do?

options.text: Put equal weight in each bag.
Put different amounts of weight in each bag.
Put as much weight as possible in one bag.

questions.correctAnswerText: Put equal weight in each bag.
questions.explanation: Distribute the weight equally between the saddlebags. Uneven weight can cause the motorcycle to lean to one side.

questions.question: What is the danger of wind noise when riding a motorcycle?

options.text: You can easily get used to it.
It can permanently damage your hearing.

questions.correctAnswerText: It can permanently damage your hearing.
questions.explanation: Long-term wind noise can permanently hurt your hearing. Wear ear plugs or other hearing protection when riding.

questions.question: Which one is NOT a real type of helmet?
questions.explanation: The two main helmet types are full-face and three-quarter. Full-face helmets give the best protection in a crash.

questions.question: How can you tell if your rear tire suddenly goes flat?

options.text: The back of your motorcycle sways side to side.

questions.correctAnswerText: The back of your motorcycle sways side to side.
questions.explanation: A flat rear tire causes the back of the motorcycle to jerk or sway from side to side. Stop riding immediately and check your tires if you feel this movement.

questions.question: When vehicles are on both sides of you, which lane position is safest?
questions.explanation: The best lane position depends on road and traffic conditions. When vehicles are on both sides, the center position is usually the safest.

questions.question: What should you do when entering a turn?
questions.explanation: Reduce your speed before turning. Taking a turn too fast can cause you to slide out of your lane or off the road.

questions.question: How should you stop quickly on a motorcycle?

options.text: Use both the front and rear brakes at the same time.

questions.correctAnswerText: Use both the front and rear brakes at the same time.
questions.explanation: Apply controlled pressure to both brakes at the same time to stop quickly. Do not lock the brakes.

questions.question: What does a solid red arrow in a traffic signal mean?

options.text: You must come to a complete stop.
You must yield to oncoming traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: A solid red arrow means the same as a red light. You must stop and wait until the signal allows you to turn.

questions.question: What should you do when approaching a blind intersection?

options.text: Assume other drivers will yield to you.
Move to the lane position where other drivers can see you best.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move to the lane position where other drivers can see you best.
questions.explanation: Position yourself in the lane where other drivers can see you most clearly when approaching a blind intersection.

questions.question: What should you do the first time you ride an unfamiliar motorcycle?

options.text: Just start riding. Learning by doing is the best way.
Just start riding. Most bikes are similar, so you don't need to check safety features.
Practice the throttle, clutch, and brakes before riding to learn how the bike works.

questions.correctAnswerText: Practice the throttle, clutch, and brakes before riding to learn how the bike works.
questions.explanation: Every motorcycle is different. Before you ride an unfamiliar bike, get to know how it works. Check the safety and maintenance. Find where everything is. Practice the throttle, clutch, and brakes a few times to learn how it operates.

questions.question: Why should you use your mirrors when stopping at an intersection?

options.text: To see if drivers behind you notice you are stopping.
To look for dark clouds that show bad weather.

questions.correctAnswerText: To see if drivers behind you notice you are stopping.
questions.explanation: Always check your mirrors to watch for vehicles coming up behind you. This helps you see if drivers are paying attention to you and your actions. Use your mirrors when stopping to make sure drivers behind you are responding to what you are doing.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black letters or symbols. They tell drivers about road conditions ahead. This sign warns that the right lane ends.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black letters or symbols. They tell drivers about road conditions ahead. This sign warns that a stop sign is coming.

questions.question: What is required to get a motorcycle endorsement?

options.text: Have no traffic violations on your record.

questions.explanation: In Delaware, you must have a valid driver's license before you can apply for a motorcycle endorsement.
